missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Молоко' stays in the nominative as the subject. 'Это' is the agreeing neuter demonstrative, and 'скисло' agrees in neuter gender.
Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Молоко' is the accusative direct object of 'купил'. Neuter nouns keep the same form in the accusative as the nominative.
Strategic focus: Genitive of absence. 'Молока' takes the genitive after 'нет' to express that there is none. The neuter genitive singular ends in -а.
Strategic focus: Dative after preposition. 'Молоку' takes the dative after 'к', showing movement toward the milk. The neuter dative singular ends in -у.
Strategic focus: Instrumental after preposition. 'Молоком' takes the instrumental after 'с', meaning together with. The neuter instrumental singular ends in -ом.
Strategic focus: Prepositional of location. 'Молоке' takes the prepositional after 'в' to show what is contained inside. The neuter prepositional singular ends in -е.
Strategic focus: Genitive of quantity. 'Молока' takes the genitive after 'немного', the partitive way to ask for some of an uncountable substance. The neuter genitive ends in -а.
Strategic focus: Genitive after measure. 'Молока' takes the genitive after 'стакан' to mean a glass of milk. 'Тёплого' agrees in the neuter genitive.
Strategic focus: Nominative plural. 'Молоки' is the nominative plural subject of 'стоят', used here for different milk varieties on a shelf. The neuter plural ends in -и after к.

missions.phrase: Без молока каша не такая вкусная.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Genitive after preposition. 'Молока' takes the genitive after 'без' to express absence. The neuter genitive singular ends in -а.
